title: feat(system): ISO 27001:2022 compliance schemas — incident response, supplier security, training, audit governance
body:
Closes schema gaps identified in the ISO 27001:2022 compliance audit that block certification at the organizational control layer.

### New schemas

- **`system/incident-response.zod.ts`** (A.5.24–A.5.28) — Incident severity/category/status enums, NIST SP 800-61 response phases, notification matrix with escalation chains, org-level response policy
- **`system/supplier-security.zod.ts`** (A.5.19–A.5.22) — Supplier risk levels, per-requirement compliance assessment, remediation tracking, reassessment policy
- **`system/training.zod.ts`** (A.6.3) — Course definitions with validity/passing scores, completion records, org training plans with recertification intervals

### Extended schemas

- **`system/compliance.zod.ts`** (A.5.35) — `AuditScheduleSchema` for recurring internal/external audits, `AuditFindingSchema` with severity→remediation→verification lifecycle. `ComplianceConfigSchema` gains `auditSchedules` field.
- **`system/change-management.zod.ts`** (A.8.32) — `securityImpact` optional field on `ChangeRequestSchema`: risk level, affected data classifications, security reviewer sign-off workflow
- **`system/security-context.zod.ts`** — Extracted `DataClassificationSchema` and `ComplianceFrameworkSchema` as canonical shared enums, eliminating inline duplication across all security subsystem schemas

```ts
// Security impact assessment on change requests (A.8.32)
const change = ChangeRequestSchema.parse({
  // ...existing fields...
  securityImpact: {
    assessed: true,
    riskLevel: 'high',
    affectedDataClassifications: ['pii', 'confidential'],
    requiresSecurityApproval: true,
    reviewedBy: 'ciso',
    reviewedAt: Date.now(),
  },
});
```

### Deduplication with existing protocols

- **`DataClassificationSchema`** (`pii/phi/pci/financial/confidential/internal/public`) — extracted from `security-context.zod.ts` as canonical source; all new schemas import instead of inlining. Also replaced 3 pre-existing inline copies within `security-context.zod.ts` itself.
- **`ComplianceFrameworkSchema`** (`gdpr/hipaa/sox/pci_dss/ccpa/iso27001`) — extracted from `security-context.zod.ts`; used by both existing `ComplianceAuditRequirementSchema` and new `AuditFindingSchema`/`AuditScheduleSchema`.
- Verified no conceptual overlap between new and existing schemas:
  - `incident-response` (incident lifecycle management) ≠ `audit.zod.ts` (automated event logging)
  - `AuditScheduleSchema` (planned human audits) ≠ `AuditConfigSchema` (automated audit trail config)
  - `AuditFindingSeveritySchema` (critical/major/minor/observation) ≠ `AuditEventSeverity` (syslog-style debug→emergency)
  - `IncidentNotificationRuleSchema` (severity-based escalation with pagerduty) ≠ `NotificationConfigSchema` (general delivery channels)

### Infrastructure

- Barrel exports updated in `system/index.ts`
- 73 new tests across 5 files (6275 total, all passing)
- `ROADMAP.md` — new Phase 6.5 section tracking ISO 27001 schema coverage

### Not in scope (tracked in roadmap)

- OAuth scope binding on API endpoints (A.8.1)
- Permission registry refactor from `string[]` to structured enum (A.8.2)
- Temporary privilege elevation protocol

> <issue_title>ISO 27001:2022 合规性差距分析与强化计划</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 根据对当前协议仓库的全面审计，ObjectStack Protocol 在技术控制与安全治理层具备良好基础（符合大部分 ISO 27001:2022 的技术要求），但在组织管理层面仍存在几项必要补充以满足认证：
> 
> ## 主要合规差距与建议行动（基于 ISO 27001:2022 最新要求）
> 
> ### 1. 🔴 高优先级（直接阻碍认证）
> - [ ] **信息安全事件管理**（A.5.24-5.28）
>     - 建议：新增 `system/incident-response.zod.ts`，实现安全事件分类、严重性分级、响应流程、通知矩阵等 schema。
> - [ ] **信息安全独立审查**（A.5.35）
>     - 建议：在 `compliance.zod.ts` 扩展审计调度、发现追踪 schema，支持独立评估与追踪建议整改。
> - [ ] **变更管理安全审批**（A.8.32）
>     - 建议：在 `change-management.zod.ts` 中完善审批流程，增加安全影响评估节点。
> 
> ### 2. 🟡 中优先级（影响合规完整性）
> - [ ] **供应商安全评估**（A.5.19-5.22）
>     - 建议：新增 `system/supplier-security.zod.ts`，记录供应商安全审查与风险评估。
> - [ ] **OAuth Scope 明确绑定**（A.8.1）
>     - 建议：API 端点 schema 补充所需 OAuth Scopes。
> - [ ] **权限注册中心**（A.8.2）
>     - 建议：将 `manifest.permissions` 从 string[] 改造为注册中心枚举 schema。
> - [ ] **信息安全培训追踪**（A.6.3）
>     - 建议：建立培训计划与完成记录 schema。
> 
> ### 3. 🟢 低优先级（增强项）
> - 权限委派与临时权限提升协议（如 AWS STS AssumeRole 类库型）；设备信任策略扩展等。
> 
> ## 支持性依据
> - `iso27001` 已为一等公民合规框架（`ComplianceAuditRequirementSchema`/`ComplianceEncryptionRequirementSchema`）；相关安全上下文治理已涵盖大部分技术控制指标。
> - 但组织控制与合规治理（如事件管理、审计调度、供应商、培训）需补全 schema 才能满足 ISO 27001 全面认证。
> 
> ## 验证方法
> - 新增/完善 schema 后，全量运行测试用例（已存在 6,202 个通过测试）。
> - 用例应覆盖 ISO 27001 合规相关的新业务场景与边界。
> 
> ## 路线建议
> - 参考本 Issue，分子任务创建 Roadmap 多项子 issue，确保规范修正后组织盖章认证可一次通过。
>
